name: Coverbox Long Term Capital Gain Tax Calculator
author: jkachhara

sections.description:
The Coverbox Long Term Capital Gain (LTCG) Tax Calculator helps property owners and investors in India quickly estimate their tax liability when selling property.
It provides results with and without indexation benefit, helping users understand the difference in taxation.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the coverbox-ltcg-calculator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Use shortcode [coverbox_ltcg_calculator] in any page or post to display the calculator.
sections.changelog:
1.0

  • Initial release of the Coverbox LTCG Calculator.
